purpose: Versioned, evidence-backed mapping from registered components and their declared consumers to repository test targets for R/O/G pull-request validation.
claim_ceiling: This map selects repository validation only. It does not establish real-world causal effects, grant execution or publication authority, or replace required shared security, permission, evidence, review, or release checks.
